description: the integrator's own manifest: wiring a package asked for in its notes, kept out of the package's manifest so that the package's schema test and its file stay as pushed

smoke.what: MLP streaming config g3u4d3 (the card-M sweep winner)

notes: Wiring the packages asked for in their notes. smoke_rules: each package's stricter smoke module (a host-side module of scripts/ci with problems(env, container_text)) is called once per arm by c2_smoke_check.fusion_problems: WP1 tp4_shard_argmax_smoke (fold, words=1, tasks = 2 x workers, the audit for four chips), WP5 ccl_options_smoke (counts, canonical set name, one audit line per op and block owner), WP6 draft_wp6_smoke (chains, the fused gate|up, the mm grid), WP7 draft_permute_smoke (an engaged line per site and shape, a passing audit line per quad site), WP2 kv_page_writer_tp4_smoke (the generated rules plus an engaged line with ordered=0: the captured forward ran the page launch). pack_order: the integrated pack runs the levers by the plan's estimated saving per 8-live round (section 6.1, central values): permute -6.4 ms, s1 -1.85, head64 -1.78, ccl -2 (unknown), reduce -1.2, qkv1 -1.1, tail -0.8, gateup1, mmgrid; kvpage (-2.75, its card-M proof now recorded) follows s1. pack_include: the upload-p0 pack's six profile twins come from its own generator (make_upload_profiles.py); its templates A0-A3 and T0-T5 are folded into the integrated ORDER under the prefix UP (UPA0.., UPT0..), on the one image, with their NEEDS lines renamed (its B0 is the pack's X0). WP4: mlpcfg (the streaming config and the L1 multiply, exact by construction) runs after head64; mlpgu (the fused gate|up, never compiled on a card) is last by WP4's own pack_last. combined: the 'all' twins (-fx-all, -fx-all-audit) and the combined mini-pack (references/fusion-jobs/combined). The CCL value is the lever's own (rs-c1, WP5's P0 winner; it needs QWEN_FAST_TP4_RS_UNIT_MAJOR=1, which the production profile already sets); mlpcfg is overridden to g3u4d3, the card-M sweep's winner (the lever's own value is l1); kvpage joins the combined set now that its proof is recorded.

pack_include.reason: tp4/upload-p0: the engine-start levers QWEN_FAST_DEVICE_ZEROS and QWEN_FAST_LAZY_SHARD_W (exactness A0-A3, then the engine-start ABAB T0-T5 read with engine_start_phases.py, which can run anywhere in the timed block).

combined.name: all
combined.reason: every lever that is exact by construction on together, to be timed and audited once before any ablation: the drafter permutations, S1 with the tree fold, the drafter reduce, fused q|k|v, tail kernels, fused gate|up weight and device-width matmul grids, the 64-row drafter head, the CCL options at the sweep winner rs-c1 (chunks per sync 1 on the unit-major reduce-scatters; exact, 5 of 5 pairs, 16.9 to 14.7 us per call), the K/V page writer (its card-M proof passed and is recorded in ordered_writer_evidence_tp4.json: the full run 1976 of 1976 exact, both negative controls fail), the MLP streaming config g3u4d3 (card-M sweep: the composed gate, up and down chain 170.4 to 162.1 us per layer, exact), and the two engine-start upload levers; NOT the fused MLP gate|up (its kernels have never compiled on a card)
